name: RP2 BLE Tracker
description: The `rp2_ble_tracker` component scans for Bluetooth Low Energy advertisements on the Raspberry Pi **Pico W** and **Pico 2 W** — the platform analog of [ESP32 BLE Tracker](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble_tracker/). It builds on the [RP2040 BLE](https://esphome.io/components/rp2040_ble/) stack component and loads it automatically.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used to reference this component.

config_entries.label: Rp2040 BLE ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the [RP2040 BLE](https://esphome.io/components/rp2040_ble/) component this tracker uses.

config_entries.label: Active
config_entries.description: Whether to send scan requests asking devices for more data after their advertisement. The scan response arrives as a separate report; it is not merged into the advertisement. Turning this off saves power on the advertising devices and radio time on the shared CYW43439. Defaults to `true`.

config_entries.label: Continuous
config_entries.description: If true, scanning starts at boot and runs forever. If false, scanning does **not** start automatically; a scan must be started from a lambda (`id(my_tracker).start_scan();`) and stops again after `duration`. Defaults to `true`.

config_entries.label: Duration
config_entries.description: Length of one scan period. In continuous mode the scan period restarts every `duration`; in non-continuous mode the scan stops after this long. Must cover at least three scan intervals. Defaults to `5min`.

config_entries.label: Interval
config_entries.description: How often the radio opens a scan window. The controller accepts 2.5 ms to 10240 ms in 0.625 ms steps. Defaults to `100ms`.

config_entries.label: Window
config_entries.description: How long the radio listens within each interval. Must not be larger than the interval; the same range and step apply. Defaults to `30ms`.
